# Protocol compatibility fixtures

`protocol_27_inferred` records a real hello/new-game/inferred Barnard plan/commit/flight session from main `70c445c3f5656479505d4e8176e8b4a194350a30` (relativity 0.11.0). `make ism-compat` compares its original bytes with the current service on both engines. Do not regenerate the expected file from the new implementation.
